{
  "name": "installguard",
  "displayName": "Install Guard",
  "version": "0.1.11",
  "description": "Looks up every new package before it installs: holds made-up names, typosquats, days-old releases and curl-into-shell for your answer, and lets the rest through.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gary Riches",
    "url": "https://github.com/griches"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/griches/installguard",
  "repository": "https://github.com/griches/installguard",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/griches/installguard/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/griches/installguard#readme",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/griches/installguard/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "security",
    "supply-chain",
    "npm",
    "pypi",
    "cargo",
    "typosquatting",
    "slopsquatting",
    "guard",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "hold": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "What is held",
      "description": "flagged: only a command that names a flagged package or fetches from outside a registry. always: every command that adds a package the project does not already have.",
      "options": [
        "flagged",
        "always"
      ],
      "default": "flagged"
    },
    "sensitivity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sensitivity",
      "description": "What counts as new, fresh and little used. relaxed: 7 days, 1 day, 100 downloads a week. balanced: 30 days, 3 days, 1,000. strict: 90 days, 7 days, 10,000.",
      "options": [
        "relaxed",
        "balanced",
        "strict"
      ],
      "default": "balanced"
    },
    "unreachable": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "When a registry cannot be reached",
      "description": "allow: the command runs and the pane notes it was not checked. hold: the command waits for your answer.",
      "options": [
        "allow",
        "hold"
      ],
      "default": "allow"
    },
    "toasts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Say when a package passes",
      "description": "Show a short toast with a package's age and weekly downloads when nothing about it is flagged.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
